title: The receipt
logline: Friday. The rent, under the tavern's door, on time, with room to spare. The landlord's hand pushes a receipt back under. The first receipt in two years. Wood, small, reads it on his knees.

panels.composition: The alley. WOOD, two-thirds, kneeling at the tavern's back door, pushing an envelope under. BARNABY.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a small man kneeling at a tavern's back door in an alley pushing an envelope beneath it, a normal-sized dog beside him

panels.composition: The door. A beat. A slip of paper coming back out under it, pushed by fingers.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, close-up of a slip of paper being pushed out from under a door by unseen fingers

panels.composition: The receipt. PAID · DEC. A signature that is a blank shape.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, close-up of a handwritten receipt reading PAID with a blank shape where a signature would be
image.notes: Letter after: PAID · DEC. The landlord's name stays blank.

panels.composition: Wood, small, on his knees in the alley, reading a receipt. The dog's chin on his shoulder — the dog is that much bigger. The garage door open behind them, the CRT glowing.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a small man on his knees in an alley reading a receipt while a normal-sized dog rests its chin on his shoulder, a garage door open behind with a monitor's glow, no words

art.palette: limited; Sundays in watercolor, good now
art.paper: bristol; the browser; from 2008 coastal newsprint a week behind

notes: The first receipt. The dog's chin on his shoulder.
